verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents dispositioning alerts and an automatic audit trail covering all work in the platform. That plausibly covers resolving a false positive with an audit record. Nothing documents reopening or overriding a resolved decision; the auto-opening 'pending' review is a scheduled periodic re-review, not an analyst reopen or override. Missing for 10: explicit false-positive resolution workflow, documented reopen/override of a closed decision, audit-record detail for overrides, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can resolve a false positive and reopen or override the decision with an audit record

citations.quote: Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
Automatic audit trail: This feature ensures that you have comprehensive audits of all work that occurs in Hummingbird.
